hero.title: I'm Aurel De Vince
hero.subtitle: Doctoral Researcher in Applied Economics and Econometrics
hero.description: I study how firms and territories evolve through innovation, sustainability, and cross-border dynamics, using data, indicators, and econometric methods.
hero.caption: Applied economics · innovation · territories

about.description1: I am a doctoral researcher in applied economics and econometrics. My work connects data, quantitative methods, and economic analysis to make transformations in firms and territories more observable and open to discussion.
about.description2: My background covers the analytical chain: data collection and structuring, modelling, indicator design, visualisation, and communication of both findings and limits.
about.description3: I favour research that informs decisions without separating methodological rigour from the economic context it addresses.

researchPreview.title: Observing economic transformation without losing its context.
researchPreview.description: My PhD is part of the OISE project: the development of a cross-border economic observatory focused on innovation, sustainability, and the performance of firms and the territory.

measurement.title: Measurement and decision-making
measurement.description: Designing indicators and analyses whose assumptions, uncertainty, and limits remain visible.

approach.title: From an economic question to genuinely usable evidence.
approach.description: Tools do not come before the problem. Each project starts with a mechanism to understand and ends with a communication that makes both conclusions and uncertainty legible.

question.title: Frame the question
question.description: Define the phenomenon, the actors involved, and the decision that analysis can inform.

evidence.title: Build the evidence
evidence.description: Assess the data, its scope, blind spots, and conditions for comparison.

method.title: Choose a proportionate method
method.description: Use econometrics, statistics, or modelling only when their assumptions genuinely answer the problem.

decision.title: Report with care
decision.description: Make results, uncertainty, limits, and possible actions visible without turning an estimate into certainty.
